skill_name: Rewrite the instructions given to the recruiters while recruiting new interns.
workflow: Recruiters should evaluate resumes, conduct interviews, and make selections when recruiting new interns. During the interviews, it is important to enquire about potential intern’s qualifications, skills, and interests to determine if they are a good fit for the role. It is also important to ask probing questions to assess their critical thinking, problem solving, and communication skills.
